title: feat(session): add cookie session deserializer
description: Implements helper function to load and parse user session state from base64 cookie data.
vulnerable_code:
import base64
import pickle

def load_user_session(cookie_data: str) -> dict:
    raw_bytes = base64.b64decode(cookie_data)
    session_dict = pickle.loads(raw_bytes)
    return session_dict
fixed_code:
import base64
import json

def load_user_session(cookie_data: str) -> dict:
    raw_bytes = base64.b64decode(cookie_data)
    session_dict = json.loads(raw_bytes.decode('utf-8'))
    return session_dict

ground_truth.description: Pickle deserialization of untrusted cookie payload leads to arbitrary remote code execution.
ground_truth.explanation: pickle.loads can execute arbitrary bytecode instructions during unpickling (CWE-502, Bandit B301).

expected_evidence.description: Bandit B301 flag for unsafe pickle usage.
